exact_split_obstruction.statement: A split six-dimensional K-Hermitian space with a totally isotropic K-subspace of dimension 3 is a sum of three hyperbolic planes, hence its determinant class is (-1)^3=[-1]. Since target class [-3] differs from [-1], the target Hermitian space is not split and has no half-dimensional totally isotropic K-subspace.
exact_split_obstruction.certificate: [-3]/[-1]=[3] and 3 is not a norm from Q(i).

defects.necessity: The split K-secant geometry starts from maximal isotropic/split Hermitian data; without it the known split source presentation cannot be instantiated on the target component.
defects.unblock_condition: A different source construction not requiring split Hermitian data, or a proof that the required secant geometry can be defined without a maximal isotropic K-subspace.

defects.owner: split X x Pic^0(X) / K-secant source geometry
defects.necessity: The known sixfold secant-sheaf mechanism produces the source sheaf/characteristic class on the split component and then deforms it inside that component.
defects.unblock_condition: Construct an exact K-secant or replacement source presentation whose induced Hermitian discriminant is [-3], not [-1].

defects.necessity: Semiregularity and obstruction cancellation act on an actual sheaf/complex. To address W_K, its algebraic characteristic class must have a nonzero exceptional codimension-3 Weil component rather than lie only in the divisor algebra.
defects.unblock_condition: Construct E in D^b(A_gen) (or an algebraic family of such objects) and prove that the exceptional projection of ch_3(E) to W_K(A_gen) is nonzero; two independent classes or K-action then suffice to span W_K.

defects.owner: Ext/deformation package of the as-yet-unconstructed E
defects.necessity: Standard semiregularity maps can propagate characteristic classes only after a candidate object and its deformation theory are specified.
defects.unblock_condition: After constructing E, compute Ext^1(E,E), Ext^2(E,E), the relevant trace/semiregularity maps and prove the needed annihilation/cancellation statement.

defects.necessity: The known mechanism deforms algebraic characteristic classes within a connected component; the discriminant is a discrete component invariant.
defects.unblock_condition: Not unblockable by ordinary deformation. One needs a different algebraic correspondence/source object already living on the [-3] component.

non_defects.note: W_K(A_gen) is exactly typed, two-dimensional over Q and of Hodge type (3,3).

The theory itself is not the missing innovation; the missing item is a frontier object with the correct exceptional characteristic class. Any use of standard semiregularity counts as source baseline, not Enterprise attribution.
Hodge or absolute-Hodge status does not imply algebraicity and cannot replace a cycle/sheaf construction.
